decisions.business: Whether each box instance is placed into the container
decisions.completeness: List the selection status of all M candidate box instances (1 = selected, 0 = not selected)

decisions.business: The 3D coordinates of each box in the container (front-left-bottom corner)
decisions.completeness: List the [x, y, z] coordinates of all M box instances; coordinates of unselected boxes are filled with [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]

decisions.business: The rotation orientation index chosen for each box (0-5)
decisions.completeness: List the orientation indices of all M box instances; unselected boxes may be represented by -1 or 0
